title: Zen - From Migration Project to Migration Agent
disclosure: Illustrative customer scenario. Simulated product UI and migration data. Synthetic voices.

scenes.title: Give Zen the goal. Let Zen own the migration.

cues.speaker: Maya
cues.text: We're moving our IT operations to Freshservice. Three weeks to go live.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: For an enterprise, moving to a new ITSM platform sounds simple. Until you realize you have to move everything that makes your business work.

cues.speaker: Maya
cues.text: Rahul, can you handle the migration?

cues.speaker: Rahul
cues.text: I'll start with the employees, then the tickets.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Two systems. Different schemas. Every field needs a decision.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: A field with no match. Priorities that don't translate. Missing requesters. And suddenly, thousands of notifications.

cues.speaker: Maya
cues.text: What do we do with these?

cues.speaker: Rahul
cues.text: We need to investigate them.

cues.speaker: Sarah
cues.text: Are we ready for go-live?

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: And that's the real problem. Migration isn't just about moving data. It's about knowing whether you can trust the migration.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Zen. The autonomous enterprise migration agent.

cues.speaker: Maya
cues.text: Migrate all employees and tickets from Jira Service Management to Freshservice.

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: Goal understood.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: One goal. Zen identifies the source, the target, and the work ahead.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Zen discovers the entities and fields on both sides. Customers become requesters. Tickets keep their context. Field mappings are created automatically.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Instead of importing everything and hoping it works, Zen tests the migration first.

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: One hundred records tested. Ninety-eight successful. Two automatically remediated. Zero critical errors.

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: Migration is ready.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Ten thousand records. Then, a requester can't be found.

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: Diagnosing.

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: A verified email match. Resolved.

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: This requester cannot be safely resolved. Human review required.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Zen doesn't hide failures. It fixes what it safely can, and brings a human in only when judgment is required.

cues.speaker: Maya
cues.text: Zen, what went wrong?

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: The primary issue was missing requester information. I automatically resolved records where a reliable requester match was found. Seventy records require human review.

cues.speaker: Sarah
cues.text: Are we ready?

cues.speaker: Zen
cues.text: The migration is reconciled and the remaining exceptions are clearly identified.

cues.speaker: Narrator
cues.text: Give Zen the goal. Let Zen own the migration.
